reviews.reviewText:
* Big Data Definitions & Technologies
Foundational understanding of Big Data, Hadoop ecosystem, HDFS, MapReduce workflow.

* Hive & HiveQL Basics
CRUD operations, table creation & loading, executing queries, basic joins.

* HIVEQL Functions & Concepts
Filtering, GROUP BY, window functions; join & aggregate syntax in Hive.

* Hadoop Components
HDFS structure (NameNode, DataNodes), fault tolerance, block replication.

* MapReduce Processing Steps
Mapper, Combiner, Reducer roles; input/output format and examples.

* Hive vs Traditional SQL
Standard SQL vs HiveQL, use cases and limitations in dataset handling.

* Hive Tables Internal vs External
Differences and implications for data storage & deletion behavior.
